{"concepts_used":["GC-0121","GC-0129"],"decline_reason":"","declined":false,"citations":[{"ref":"TMM/Part14/x-14.-annex-a13-list-of-terms-too-broad-for-classification/powders","quote":"Suggested Alternatives Class 1: Plastics in the form of powders Class 2: Paint powders Class 3: Cosmetic face powders Class 4: Wax powders for industrial purposes Class 5: Medicated baby powders Class 6: Common metal powders Class 13: Explosive powders Class 29: Powders for making milk shakes Class 30: Curry powders Class 32: Powders for effervescing beverages"},{"ref":"TMM/Part14/3#1~2","quote":"Examiners must check that goods and services are adequately described and that they are, on the basis of the description supplied, correctly classified."},{"ref":"TMM/Part14/4/4/6/2","quote":"If part or all of the specification is vague or unclear to the extent that it cannot be classified, the Examiner should request further information from the applicant."},{"ref":"TMR1995/r4.2(1)(c)","quote":"(c) specify the goods and/or services in relation to which the application is made; and"}],"answer":"Use wording identifying the kind of powder, rather than just “powders”. The Manual gives these suggested alternatives (Manual practice, not legislation):

| Class | Suggested wording |
|---|---|
| 1 | Plastics in the form of powders |
| 2 | Paint powders |
| 3 | Cosmetic face powders |
| 4 | Wax powders for industrial purposes |
| 5 | Medicated baby powders |
| 6 | Common metal powders |
| 13 | Explosive powders |
| 29 | Powders for making milk shakes |
| 30 | Curry powders |
| 32 | Powders for effervescing beverages |

Source: TMM/Part14/x-14.-annex-a13-list-of-terms-too-broad-for-classification/powders.

Choose the wording that accurately describes the actual goods. I cannot identify the appropriate class without knowing what the powders are: Manual practice requires adequate description and correct classification, and further information where the specification cannot be classified (TMM/Part14/3#1~2; TMM/Part14/4/4/6/2).

The Regulations require the application to specify its goods and/or services; the suggested wording above comes from the Manual, not the Regulations (TMR1995/r4.2(1)(c))."}
